scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['node_modules/@img','node_modules/sharp'].forEach(p=>{const dir='.next/standalone/'+p; if(fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true})}); if(fs.existsSync('.next/static')) { if(fs.existsSync('.next/standalone/.next')) fs.cpSync('.next/static', '.next/standalone/.next/static', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('.next/static', 'public/_next/static', {recursive:true}); } if(fs.existsSync('public') && fs.existsSync('.next/standalone')) { fs.cpSync('public', '.next/standalone/public', {recursive:true}); }"
